summary: Tested Google OAuth UI/session behavior, authenticated homepage/routes, and requested backend APIs. Backend pytest: 8/9 passed (88.9%); health, concepts, 14 tableaux, unauthenticated and seeded authenticated /auth/me, invalid /auth/session, Gabriel, and Chat passed. Frontend login button/redirect, authenticated homepage, Gabriel query, Chat, IA Evolutive, and IA Socratique routes rendered. Critical auth bypass reproduced: a forged localStorage user grants protected UI access after /auth/me returns 401.

minor.issue: Returns a category row with categorie=null (count=6), so homepage reports 7 domain groups although only 6 are named. Data/API should exclude null or label uncategorized records.

integration_issues.issue: CRITICAL: After /api/auth/me returns 401, App trusts any JSON in localStorage['user'] and sets isAuthenticated=true. Reproduced without a cookie by storing a forged attacker@example.com object and reloading; homepage and protected routes opened.

action_items: Remove localStorage as an authentication fallback; /api/auth/me must be the sole source of authenticated state. Local storage may cache display data only after server verification.
Filter or label null categories returned by /api/categories.
Remove hardcoded secrets and credentials from source: EMERGENT_LLM_KEY fallback in server.py and access code in App.js; use environment/server-side authorization.
Replace synchronous pymongo calls in async auth routes with Motor/async operations to avoid blocking the event loop.
Add data-testid attributes to Chat, IA Evolutive, IA Socratique, logout, legal navigation, and remaining Gabriel controls.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 7,215 lines and App.js is 12,411 lines; split API domains into APIRouters/services and UI pages into modules.
Auth uses synchronous MongoClient operations inside async FastAPI endpoints.
server.py embeds an EMERGENT_LLM_KEY default and App.js embeds the privileged upload access code; both are client/source-visible credential leaks.
CORS combines allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True; configure the explicit frontend origin.
Environment configuration violates fail-fast requirements by providing localhost/database/key defaults in server.py and google_auth_service.py.
Frontend lint reports undefined variables in rendered code paths (including HomePage LaTeX controls) and 177 total problems; this remains a regression risk.
google_auth_service.py referenced in the request exists, but the requested /app/backend/modules/gabriel_service.py path does not; actual module is /app/backend/modules/gabriel/gabriel_service.py.

success_rate.frontend: 85.7% (6 requested UI/route checks passed; authentication enforcement failed)

seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned TEST OAuth-compatible user/session records for API and browser testing.
test_credentials: No Google test identity was available; followed auth_testing.md and used temporary seeded sessions. Real OAuth exchange was not executed. Invalid session exchange correctly returned 401.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Re-run backend_test.py and specifically retry forged-localStorage access after auth fix. Use server-seeded cookie to inspect gated routes. Requested AI endpoints currently pass; IA Socratique challenger and IA Evolutive statistics were additionally smoke-tested as 200.
rca_of_the_issue: App.js lines 12187-12212 treat localStorage user JSON as proof of identity whenever /api/auth/me fails or returns non-OK. localStorage is attacker-controlled, so any visitor can forge a user object and bypass the auth wrapper. The server endpoints tested are also publicly callable, so UI gating does not protect API data/functions.
